//: Who sings from where. Looked up from the script, cast per LINE; pitch is a diagnostic, never the source. One speaker, one voice, one timing track. Made-up content.
source: script from the film's published screenplay; lines checked by the owner by ear 2026-11-02
//lit_all_song: a dedicated singing prop stays lit all song (idle = a fixed closed mouth between lines); a face on a multiprop stays windowed to its lines

characters.//Chorus: a group line is sung by every named character on its OWN track — never a collective bucket

lines.//recovered: found under the lead by spectral contrast; the transcript absorbed it. Lives here, never back in the transcript

//verified: every word's pronunciation checked (a dictionary, never letters) and every 2+ syllable word broken into 2+ mouth shapes — the validator refuses otherwise
//hand_edited: true once the owner has edited these tracks in xLights: then the chain REFUSES to rebuild them and the only legal direction is reading the tracks back from the .xsq
//blink: xLights' Auto never blinks a node-range face; blinks are PLACED, and every line entry pre-closes the mouth
